steps.title: Prepare yeast culture
steps.instruction: Streak frozen yeast stock on a YPD agar plate with a sterile tip and incubate at 30 °C for ~48 h until colonies appear. Pick a single colony into 50 ml YPD liquid in a 250 ml Erlenmeyer flask, shake at 200 rpm, 30 °C overnight. Dilute the overnight culture into 1.5 L fresh YPD in a 2 800 ml polycarbonate flask to an initial OD₆₀₀ of 0.05‑0.1 and grow at 200 rpm, 30 °C until OD₆₀₀ reaches 0.5‑0.8 (≈20‑30 L total culture per strain for low‑abundant RNPs).

steps.title: Cross‑link cells with formaldehyde
steps.instruction: Add 37 % formaldehyde to the culture to a final concentration of 1 % (v/v) in a fume hood, agitate gently on an orbital shaker at room temperature for 2 min. Quench with glycine to a final concentration of 125 mM, incubate 5 min at room temperature with gentle agitation.

steps.title: Harvest and freeze cell pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge cultures at 3 000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C in centrifuge bottles, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in ~100 ml pre‑cooled ddH₂O, pool and centrifuge again at 3 000 × g for 1 min at 4 °C in 50 ml Falcon tubes, discard supernatant, weigh pellet, flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C (≈40 g pellet needed per strain).

steps.title: Lyse cells with bead beating
steps.instruction: Resuspend frozen pellet in pre‑chilled RIPA buffer (2 ml per gram of pellet). Aliquot ~1.2 ml into 2 ml screw‑cap tubes each containing 200 µl of 150‑212 µm and 200 µl of 450‑600 µm acid‑washed glass beads (≈70‑90 tubes). Lyse on a FastPrep® at 4 °C, speed 6.5 m sec⁻¹ for 3‑5 cycles of 45 s with 5 min on ice between cycles. Verify lysis microscopically.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge lysates at 1 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, transfer supernatant to clean 2 ml tubes, pool 2‑3 tubes into one tube (≈30‑40 pooled tubes total).

steps.title: RNase T1 treatment of lysate
steps.instruction: Add RNase T1 to a final concentration of 50 U ml⁻¹, incubate 15 min at 22 °C with end‑over‑end rotation, then place on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: Pellet membranes and wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 20 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, wash pellet once with 1 ml RIPA buffer per tube (centrifuge 20 000 × g, 10 min, 4 °C, discard supernatant).

steps.title: Prepare streptavidin beads
steps.instruction: In a 15 ml Falcon tube, pre‑wash streptavidin agarose beads: 1) 3‑4 bed volumes nuclease‑free water, centrifuge 800 × g at RT, discard; 2) 3‑4 bed volumes incubation buffer, centrifuge 800 × g at RT, discard. Resuspend beads in incubation buffer to a 50 % slurry (1 ml per 5‑8 tubes).

steps.title: Bind lysate to beads overnight
steps.instruction: Combine pooled lysate (1 ml incubation buffer per tube) with 50 µl pre‑washed streptavidin beads (bed volume) in a 15 ml Falcon tube, rotate end‑over‑end at room temperature overnight (≈250‑400 µl beads total).

steps.title: Wash beads after binding
steps.instruction: Wash beads 3‑4 times with 10 ml wash buffer, centrifuge 800 × g at room temperature each time, discard supernatant. Transfer beads to a 1.5 ml LoBind tube, centrifuge 800 × g at RT, discard supernatant.

steps.title: RNase T1 treatment on beads
steps.instruction: Wash beads 3 times with 1 ml PNK buffer (no DTT), centrifuge 800 × g at 4 °C each time, discard. Resuspend beads in one bed volume PNK buffer (no DTT) and add RNase T1 to 100 U µl⁻¹, incubate 15 min at 22 °C with occasional mixing, then place on ice 5 min. Wash beads 5 times with 1 ml PNK buffer (no DTT), centrifuge 800 × g at 4 °C, discard.

steps.title: Dephosphorylate RNA with CIP
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in one bed volume NEBuffer 3 containing calf intestinal phosphatase (CIP) at 0.5 U µl⁻¹, incubate 10 min at 37 °C, shaking 800 rpm. Wash beads twice with 1 ml PNK buffer (no DTT) and twice with 1 ml PNK buffer, centrifuge 800 × g at 4 °C each time, discard.

steps.title: 5′ end‑label with PNK and γ‑32P‑ATP
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in one bed volume PNK buffer, add T4 PNK and γ‑[³²P]‑ATP to final concentrations of 1 U µl⁻¹ and 0.5 µCi µl⁻¹ respectively, incubate 30 min at 37 °C, shaking 800 rpm. Set up a parallel reaction with 50‑100 ng 19 nt ssRNA size marker in 20 µl total volume, add ATP to 100 µM and incubate additional 5 min at 37 °C. Wash beads 3 times with 1 ml PNK buffer (no DTT) and twice with 1 ml PNK buffer, centrifuge 800 × g at 4 °C, discard.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Wash beads once with one bed volume 2× proteinase K buffer, discard. Resuspend beads in one bed volume 2× proteinase K buffer, add proteinase K to 1.2 mg ml⁻¹, incubate 30 min at 55 °C, shaking 800 rpm.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add one bed volume phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol (PCI), vortex 10 s, spin 10 min at 20 000 × g, RT. Transfer aqueous phase to a new 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube, add 200 µl chloroform, vortex 10 s, spin 10 min at 20 000 × g, RT, transfer aqueous phase to another LoBind tube.

steps.title: Reverse cross‑linking
steps.instruction: Heat samples at 65 °C for ≥2 h to reverse cross‑links.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Add NaCl to 0.4 M, 1 µl GlycoBlue™ and 2‑3 volumes 100 % ethanol, mix, incubate ≥30 min at –80 °C, centrifuge 30 min at 20 000 × g, 4 °C, discard supernatant, wash pellet with 200 µl 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 20 000 × g, 4 °C, discard, air‑dry, resuspend in 10 µl nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: 3′ adapter ligation (first ligation)
steps.instruction: Add 1 µl 3′ adapter (50 µM) to the RNA, denature 95 °C 30 s, snap‑cool on ice ≥3 min. Assemble 20 µl ligation mix: 6 µl 10× T4 RNA ligase buffer, 6 µl 50 % (v/v) DMSO, 1 µl T4 RNA ligase 2 (truncated), 7 µl nuclease‑free water. Incubate on ice overnight (≥12 h) in a cold room.

steps.title: Run first PAGE and excise band
steps.instruction: Pre‑run a 15 % urea polyacrylamide gel at 250 V for ≥30 min, wash wells with 1× TBE. Add 1 vol. 2× RNA loading dye, load samples and 19 nt size markers, run at 200‑250 V for 2‑3 h until bromophenol blue is ~2 cm from gel bottom. Wrap gel with Saran wrap, place phosphor screen on top, scan at intervals (5 min‑1 h). After exposure, blank screen 15‑20 min. Excise gel region containing the 3′‑ligated 19 nt marker (use printed 1:1 scan copy for guidance).

steps.title: Elute RNA from gel (first)
steps.instruction: Incubate gel slice in 0.4 M NaCl solution (1 ml per cm² gel) containing RNase inhibitor (0.1 U µl⁻¹) for 15‑20 h at 4 °C with rotation. Transfer eluate to new 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tubes (300‑400 µl per tube), add 1 µl GlycoBlue™ and 2‑3 volumes 100 % ethanol, precipitate ≥30 min at –80 °C, spin 30 min at 20 000 × g, 4 °C, wash pellet with 200 µl 70 % ethanol, centrifuge, discard, air‑dry, resuspend in 9 µl nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: 5′ adapter ligation (second ligation)
steps.instruction: Add 1 µl 5′ adapter (50 µM), denature 95 °C 30 s, ice ≥3 min. Assemble 20 µl ligation mix: 6 µl 10× reaction buffer (supplied), 6 µl 50 % (v/v) DMSO, 2 µl T4 RNA ligase 2, 2 µl T4 RNA ligase (full‑length), 4 µl nuclease‑free water. Incubate 1 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Run second PAGE and excise band
steps.instruction: Pre‑run a 12 % urea polyacrylamide gel at 250 V for ≥30 min, wash wells with 1× TBE. Add 1 vol. 2× RNA loading dye, load samples and markers, run at 200‑250 V for 1.5‑2 h until bromophenol blue is ~2 cm from bottom. Wrap gel, place phosphor screen, scan (10 min‑2 h). Blank screen 15‑20 min. Excise gel piece above the 3′‑ligated 19 nt marker.

steps.title: Elute RNA from gel (second)
steps.instruction: Elute as described for the first gel slice (0.4 M NaCl, RNase inhibitor, 15‑20 h at 4 °C, precipitation with GlycoBlue™ and ethanol, spin, wash, air‑dry). Resuspend final RNA pellet in 15 µl nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Deplete rRNA
steps.instruction: Use the Yeast RiboMinus™ Transcriptome Isolation Kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Elute rRNA‑depleted RNA in 10‑15 µl nuclease‑free water into a 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: Reverse transcription
steps.instruction: Perform cDNA synthesis with SuperScript™ III Reverse Transcriptase using the RA3_RT primer (ACCTTAAGAGCCCACGGTTCC) following the kit’s instructions.

steps.title: Determine optimal PCR cycle number
steps.instruction: Set up a pilot PCR in a 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube: 10 µl 10× Taq DNA polymerase buffer, 10 µl 10 mM dNTPs, 2 µl RP1 forward primer (100 µM), 0.5‑1 µl indexing primer (RPI1, 100 µM), 4 µl cDNA, add nuclease‑free water to 100 µl total. Aliquot 10‑20 µl into 5‑10 PCR tubes. Run: 95 °C 1 min; 30 sec 95 °C, 30 sec 55 °C, X cycles 25 sec 72 °C; 2 min 72 °C. Stop after each of the following cycle numbers: 10,12,14,16,18,20,22,24. Run 2.5 % agarose gel with RedSafe™ (1:50 000) at 180 V for 0.5‑1 h, include low‑range DNA ladder. Visualize and select the cycle where the desired product is visible but the 5′‑adapter‑3′‑adapter dimer is not over‑amplified.

steps.title: Final PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Assemble 200 µl final PCR: 20 µl 10× Taq buffer, 10 µl 10 mM dNTPs, 4 µl RP1 forward primer (100 µM), 1‑2 µl indexing primer (RPI1‑4, 100 µM), 8 µl cDNA, add nuclease‑free water to 200 µl. Run the same program with the optimal cycle number determined above.

steps.title: Purify final library from gel
steps.instruction: Run the final PCR product on a 2.5 % agarose gel with RedSafe™ (1:50 000) at 180 V for 1 h, load low‑range ladder. Visualize, excise the band corresponding to the library, and purify using the NucleoSpin® Gel and PCR Clean‑up kit per the manufacturer’s instructions. Elute in 20 µl nuclease‑free water into a 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: Assess library and sequence
steps.instruction: Analyze the purified library on a Bioanalyzer. If quality is acceptable, proceed to Illumina sequencing.

steps.title: Prepare required buffers
steps.instruction: Make the following solutions as described:

substeps.instruction: YPD agar: 1 % w/v yeast extract, 2 % w/v peptone, 2 % w/v dextrose, 2 % w/v agar.
YPD liquid medium: 1 % w/v yeast extract, 2 % w/v peptone, 2 % w/v dextrose.
RIPA buffer: 50 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl, 1 % v/v NP‑40, 0.5 % w/v sodium deoxycholate, 0.1 % w/v SDS; add one tablet proteinase inhibitor per 50 ml.
Incubation buffer: 50 mM sodium phosphate pH 8.0, 300 mM NaCl, 6 M GuHCl, 0.5 % v/v Tween‑20.
Wash buffer: same as incubation buffer plus 0.5 % v/v NP‑40.
PNK buffer: 50 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 50 mM NaCl, 10 mM MgCl₂, 5 mM DTT.
2× proteinase K buffer: 100 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 200 mM NaCl, 2 mM EDTA, 1 % w/v SDS.

Urea polyacrylamide gel (15 % or 12 %): 8 M urea, appropriate % acrylamide/bis‑acrylamide, 1× TBE; add 40 µl 10 % APS and 4 µl TEMED per 10 ml 1 M Tris‑HCl (121.14 g Tris base, pH adjusted with HCl at RT).
